title: LA Colossal – Vermilion Najeon 03 (Standing)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Spanish woman in her late 40s, black hair in a low chignon with a carved comb, natural face with a confident smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer clearly different from skin, inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl ten longevity symbols — sun, clouds, cranes, pine, deer, turtles, and waves. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one arm extended gracefully out to the side at shoulder height, the other hand on her hip, chest open. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch vermilion lacquer platform stiletto sandals with multiple thin straps across the instep and pearl studs.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, deep red.

Background & Lighting: Grand museum hall of Asian lacquerware with red walls, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm museum key with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
